check: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter agent-tick-admin check && python scripts/validate-mobile-eas-config.py
admin:check: corepack pnpm --filter agent-tick-admin check && corepack pnpm --filter agent-tick-admin build
cli:publish: cd packages/cli && corepack pnpm publish --access public --no-git-checks --no-provenance
cli:sanction: node packages/cli/dist/index.js sanction --title 'Run command?' --body 'Agent Tick test sanction from the CLI' --command 'npm install'
mobile: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 corepack pnpm start -- --host localhost --port 8081
mobile:lan: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 corepack pnpm start -- --host lan --port 8081
mobile:dev-client: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 corepack pnpm start:dev-client -- --host localhost --port 8081
mobile:dev-client:lan: cd apps/mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 corepack pnpm start:dev-client:lan -- --port 8081
mobile:dev-build:ios: cd apps/mobile && corepack pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile development --platform ios
mobile:dev-build:android: cd apps/mobile && corepack pnpm dlx eas-cli build --profile development --platform android
mobile:update:development: cd apps/mobile && corepack pnpm dlx eas-cli update --channel development
